input:
NPC: chef_assistant
Category: teaching
Concept: food safety
Difficulty: advanced
User message: How long can I keep cooked chicken in the fridge before it goes bad?
actual_output: Refrigerate cooked chicken or meat within two hours and use it within three to four days. Store it in a shallow covered container so it cools quickly, and keep raw meats below ready-to-eat foods. If it smells sour or feels slimy, toss it.

metric.name: Persona and Category Fit [GEval]
metric.reason: The response fits the persona of a chef assistant by providing practical, direct advice. It adheres to the teaching category with clear, concise information within the sentence limit.
